summary: Serve external prefix hits for align-mode Mamba hybrids through the offloading connector
details: Boundary states are captured in dedicated blocks and QSA pages transfer their padded selector tail, so OffloadingConnector prefix hits on Qwen3.8 are correct.
A restored boundary checkpoint keeps its QSA selector pools instead of treating the slot as fresh; GPU prefix-hit and LMCache restore answers were unchanged in our Qwen TP2 MTP3 checks.
Qwen still rejects OffloadingConnector until a connector declares atomic support.
